title: Private tenant activation lanes, safety checks, and experimentation playbook
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Objective: Define a prescriptive, repeatable playbook to activate Private/VPC tenants via configurable activation lanes that combine automated safety checks, metrics-driven experiment gates, and a fast rollback surface ("rollback containers"). This ticket captures scope for PM + Eng + SRE + Design work to: 1) define tenant fingerprinting metadata used to select activation lanes, 2) design safety check set (compatibility, quota, network egress rules, KMS access), 3) implement staged canary rollouts with instrumentation and automated aborts, 4) design a rollback container format and orchestration API, and 5) create customer communication and runbook templates for customer success and on-call teams.
acceptance_criteria: Tenant fingerprint spec documented and approved (metadata keys, prioritization rules)
At least three activation lanes implemented: small-canary, regional-batched, full-tranche
Automated safety-check pipeline runs pre-activation and blocks on: KMS access, networking checks, disk capacity, and model-compatibility matrix
Canary metrics dashboard and alert rule set implemented (latency p50/p95, error rate, token cost divergence, KV-cache hit rate)
Rollback container spec and a working orchestration script that can revert activation within 5 minutes in 90% of test scenarios
Customer-facing activation checklist and templated notification emails exist in Confluence
comments: 2026-02-20 - Aisha Patel: Kickoff meeting notes attached. Agreed to use tenant fingerprinting approach rather than per-customer manual lanes. Action: Eng to prototype fingerprint extraction from onboarding metadata.

2026-02-28 - Diego Martinez: ENG spike complete. Prototype extracts three labels: region, workload_class (low/med/high), and compliance_profile. Early results show >95% correct lane mapping on sample tenants.

2026-03-03 - Priya Rao (SRE): Raised concern: automated safety-check pipeline needs retries for transient KMS timeouts. Added requirement to surface per-check failure reasons to customer activation UI.
2026-03-09 - Design review (Marta Li): UI mockups for activation console ready. Emphasis on making rollback visible and one-click for first responder. Also proposed a "safety score" visualization.

2026-03-12 - Diego Martinez: Engineering plan submitted. Implementation broken into three milestones: fingerprint service (2w), safety-check pipeline + dashboard (3w), rollback container + orchestration (2w). Blocking: infra quota to run canary tranches in staging (ticket ENG-55210).

2026-03-14 - PM sync: Decided to pilot with two incoming enterprise customers (ACME Corp, Otter Health) after internal canaries. Customer success will run dry-run checklist with them prior to activation.
2026-03-15 - Security review requested (security_review_required: true). Threat modeling session scheduled 2026-03-18.
risks: - Fingerprint ambiguity: similar tenants may be routed to wrong lanes; mitigation: manual override and pre-flight dry runs. - KMS/network flakiness could block activations; mitigation: retries and clear failure reasons. - Rollback surface complexity for stateful tenants; mitigation: create predefined rollback containers and test weekly.
runbook_notes: Include step-by-step activation checklist, who to call (SRE rotation), exact metrics thresholds for automatic abort, and post-activation verification steps (latency smoke tests, cost delta checks).
